summary: ADR-0057 accepted 2026-08-05; knowledge publication owned solely by maintain-knowledge-base with separate append-only maintainer-confirmed request; request binds caller, trigger, one existing target plan, pinned main commit, timestamp, non-automatic state, authority, and hash-verified stale-maintenance route; publish command fails closed without bindings; stale catalog yields typed hash-bound non-authorizing stop persisted in target plan; VDD/Acceptance reject outputs outside exact target directory; semantic catalog excludes authority manifests and knowledge contexts to prevent recursive closure; standalone builder read-only, publication gate alone activates layers/pointers via validated capability; discovery supports versioned top-level requirements/contract/state/registry files and highest numeric version, including both ledger naming variants; historical reads and prior generations remain compatible; extends ADR-0044, ADR-0048, ADR-0050; no supersession
